releases.title: Turn It Up
releases.description: The debut album from Ransom Black. Dark country, Southern rock, and songs about love, loyalty, loss, and finding the strength to keep going. Turn it up. Feel every word.

releases.title: Ransom
releases.description: The song that introduced Ransom Black — rough-edged, restless and unapologetically his own.

releases.title: The Life I've Made
releases.description:
Inspired by a visitor's post on The Wall, "The Life I've Made" is about looking back at the road you've traveled, the choices you've made, and the life you've built along the way. It isn't about having a perfect life. It's about appreciating the one you've made.

Sometimes a few words from a stranger can become something much bigger.

Have something on your mind? Visit The Wall. Your story might inspire the next song.
